headlines.text: It was 2022 when Jon Moxley vs. Kyle O'Reilly met in a Number One Contender, in the night's main event on Dynamite, rated 8.17 ? a fantastic contest. O'Reilly had just won a wild Casino Battle Royale to earn this shot, and pushed the reigning ace to the limit before Moxley's experience saw him through to Forbidden Door.
2024 brought us this moment: Orange Cassidy vs. Kyle O'Reilly closed out Collision, rated 7.34 ? a strong outing.
Turning the clock back to 2022: David Finlay arrived in AEW against Adam Page, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.71.

secondaries.text: Flash back to 2024, when Castagnoli & Yuta vs. FTR locked horns for the first time, getting things started right out of the gate on Collision, rated 7.76 ? a strong outing.
On this day in 2024, Dustin Rhodes stepped back through the curtain after just under 2 months away, appearing on Collision.
Looking back to 2022, when PAC vs. Buddy Matthews locked horns for the first time on Dynamite, rated 7.40 ? a solid showing.
